dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deep concave curvature on the trailing edge, forming a smooth, continuous arc from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree positive slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times greater than the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve forming a prominent, smooth melon region.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle at the transition point between the melon and rostrum, creating a shallow indentation.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan-colored surface texture with simplified digital polygon shading.
